en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestoned town square with early 20th‑century buildings around it. A tramcar and a horse‑drawn cart are in the middle of the square, and several pedestrians walk about. The style of architecture is Central European, with multi‑storey stucco houses and a prominent corner building with a decorative façade and tower. The caption at the top left in red ink reads "Zittau. Kaiser Wilhelmplatz."
